title: HackerRank: Apple and Orange
description: Sam's house has an apple tree at point `a` and an orange tree at point `b`. The house is between points `s` and `t`. Apples fall at relative distances given in `apples`, and oranges in `oranges`. Return `[apples_on_house, oranges_on_house]`.
constraints:
1 <= s, t, a, b <= 10^5, a < s < t < b
• Time: O(N + M) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def count_apples_and_oranges(s: int, t: int, a: int, b: int, apples: list[int], oranges: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def count_apples_and_oranges(s: int, t: int, a: int, b: int, apples: list[int], oranges: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    app_cnt = sum(1 for d in apples if s <= a + d <= t)
    ora_cnt = sum(1 for d in oranges if s <= b + d <= t)
    return [app_cnt, ora_cnt]
explanation: Calculates absolute landing coordinates and checks inclusion in range [s, t] in O(N + M) time.
